notes.title: Version 1.09
notes.notes:
Well, if there was an achievement for world's slowest update, I just unlocked it. After stating that I would add an option to reverse the mouse axis shortly after launch, I disappeared from this game for 2 years. I won't go into all the boring details here, but it involves some some real life inconveniences like moving house multiple times, failed backups, and new computers. It may not be much but I finally got around to a few of these changes, like:

- Added mouse Y-axis reverse option
- Optimised load times
- Reduced install size
- Fixed issue with some light effects switching off
- Fixed issue with mushrooms getting stuck on pickup

I am still working on optimising the game and hope to have another update in less than 2 years...

notes.title: Update notes - V1.07
notes.notes:
A patch is now live for version 1.07 with a few changes, including:

- Fixed an issue where music would get muted randomly while using an instrument
- Added a lever to stop and reset all instruments

Cheers!
Edwin

notes.title: Update notes - V1.06
notes.notes:
A patch is now live for version 1.06 with a number of small updates, including:

- Fixed a few small bugs
- Optimization of some areas
- Added mouse sensitivity option
- Added music volume option

Cheers!
Edwin

notes.title: Update notes - V1.05 16th March
notes.notes:
Thanks to all who have played and given feedback on the game so far, it is greatly appreciated!
A patch is now live for version 1.05 that has numerous small fixes and adjustments, including:

- Reduced amount of fog
- Fixed various collision errors with objects
- Added flashing lights warning
- Fixed several missing/corrupted textures
- Improved legibility of text labels on instruments
- Adjusted audio balance of music instruments
- Fixed missing colliders in forest
- Fixed several object pickups stuck in place

Thanks again,
Edwin
